feature.label: Muse Spark Code (Unofficial)
feature.description: Muse Spark Code (Unofficial) puts Meta's Muse Spark model to work as a coding agent inside Eclipse: a chat panel in a view, file changes shown as diffs, and an approval before commands and edits. Independent and open source (MIT); not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta or the Eclipse Foundation. Requires Java 21, Node.js 22 or later and the muse-spark-code-acp runtime (npm install -g muse-spark-code-acp). You bring your own Muse subscription or Meta Model API key.
